## About this page

What a new item starts with, and how the editor opens. Each row opens its own page.

#### How it works

**New items** holds [Add menu](/guide/settings/add/), for which types the add button offers and in what order, and [Generator](/guide/settings/generator/), for what a new password looks like.

**Changing them** holds [Editor](/guide/settings/editor/), for which sections start open and which start folded.

See also [Add menu](/guide/settings/add/), [Generator](/guide/settings/generator/), [Editor](/guide/settings/editor/).
